description_expanded: AboutJust Us on 30A | Luxury Seagrove Beach Vacation Rental | South of 30A | Golf Cart Included | Walk to the Beach Home Highlights: • Just Us on 30A – gorgeous luxury vacation home in highly sought-after Seagrove Beach • Desirable location south of Scenic Highway 30A • Walk to the beach without crossing busy 30A • 6-seater street-legal golf cart included • Gorgeous luxury coastal décor and beautifully appointed interiors • Fully stocked kitchen with spices and everything needed for meals at home • Bicycles included for exploring Seagrove Beach and 30A • Four backpack beach chairs, beach umbrella, and a beach wagon included for easy trips to the sand • Private screened back porch with comfortable seating • Two acoustic guitars for guests to enjoy • Cornhole, games and playing cards • Family-friendly amenities including a Pack and Play, high chair and children's dishes • Close to Seaside, Eastern Lake, Old Florida Fish House, boutique shopping, dining and entertainment • Peaceful Seagrove Beach setting near the best of 30A, Santa Rosa Beach and the Emerald Coast • 5 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms • 4 king bedrooms • Bunk room with two sets of twin-over-twin bunk beds • Welcome Pack of Starbucks Coffee, bottles of water, dish soap, dishwasher detergent, paper towels, toilet paper, and bathroom amenity kit Welcome to Just Us on 30A, a gorgeous luxury Seagrove Beach vacation rental perfectly positioned south of Scenic Highway 30A in one of the most sought-after areas of Santa Rosa Beach, Florida. Combining an incredible location, beautiful coastal interiors and thoughtful vacation amenities, this five-bedroom 30A beach house is designed for unforgettable vacations with family and friends. Best of all, guests can walk to the beach without crossing Scenic Highway 30A. Pack the beach wagon, grab your favorite spot on the sugar-white sand and spend the day beside the emerald-green waters of the Gulf of Mexico. When you're ready to explore, hop aboard the included 6-seater street-legal golf cart or take one of the included bicycles and discover Seagrove Beach and the surrounding communities along Scenic Highway 30A. Located near beautiful Eastern Lake and just minutes from Seaside, Just Us on 30A places you close to some of the most popular beaches, restaurants, boutiques and attractions along Florida's famous 30A. Why Guests Love Just Us on 30A From the moment you arrive, Just Us on 30A feels like a true luxury coastal retreat. Gorgeous décor, stylish furnishings and a relaxed beach-inspired atmosphere create a beautiful setting for families and friends traveling together. The inviting living area offers a comfortable place to gather after a day at the beach, while the home's thoughtful layout provides plenty of sleeping space for your group. Whether your vacation plans include long beach days, leisurely bike rides along 30A, dinner at a favorite Seagrove Beach restaurant or a quiet evening playing cards on the screened porch, Just Us on 30A was designed for making vacation memories together. And for something a little different, pick up one of the home's two acoustic guitars and add a little music to your evening. Fully Stocked Kitchen The fully stocked kitchen at Just Us on 30A makes preparing breakfast before the beach, afternoon snacks or family dinners easy and enjoyable. You'll find cookware, dishes, utensils and kitchen essentials along with a selection of spices, giving you everything you need to prepare meals during your stay. Gather around for morning coffee, prepare fresh local seafood for dinner or bring home your favorite takeout from one of Seagrove Beach's many nearby restaurants. With shopping, dining and local markets nearby, everything you need for your 30A vacation is within easy reach. Five Comfortable Bedrooms After a full day exploring Seagrove Beach and the Gulf Coast, retreat to one of five comfortable bedrooms. Bedroom 1: King bed Bedroom 2: King bed Bedroom 3: King bed Bedroom 4: King bed Bedroom 5: Two sets of twin-over-twin bunk beds With four king bedrooms, couples and adult guests can enjoy comfortable sleeping accommodations without having to compromise on bed size. The bunk room features two sets of twin-over-twin bunk beds, creating a fun sleeping space for children, teens or additional guests. The home also features two full bathrooms. Private Screened Back Porch One of the most inviting spaces at Just Us on 30A is the private screened back porch, offering a comfortable place to slow down and enjoy the relaxed Seagrove Beach lifestyle. Start the morning outside with a cup of coffee, settle in with a book during the afternoon or gather together in the evening after dinner. The screened setting creates a peaceful extension of the home's living space and a wonderful place to enjoy time together. 6-Seater Street-Legal Golf Cart Included Leave the car parked and enjoy one of the most popular amenities for a 30A vacation: an included 6-seater street-legal golf cart. Cruise through Seagrove Beach, head toward nearby restaurants and shops or explore more of the surrounding 30A area. For families traveling with children or groups carrying beach gear, having a golf cart included with your Seagrove Beach vacation rental adds another level of convenience and fun to your stay. Bicycles Included Scenic Highway 30A is known for its laid-back biking culture, and Just Us on 30A includes bicycles for guests to enjoy. Take a morning ride through Seagrove, explore the area around Eastern Lake or bike toward nearby Seaside. Spend the day discovering local coffee shops, restaurants, boutiques and beautiful coastal scenery at your own pace. Walk to the Beach Everything you need for a classic Seagrove Beach vacation is close at hand. With the beach within walking distance, getting to the Gulf is easy. Load towels, toys and beach essentials into the included beach wagon and head toward the sugar-white sand. Spend the morning swimming in the emerald-green Gulf waters, take a long walk along the shoreline or stay until sunset paints the sky over the Gulf of Mexico. Being south of 30A means guests can walk toward the beach without needing to cross Scenic Highway 30A, an especially convenient feature when vacationing with children. Family-Friendly Amenities and Entertainment Just Us on 30A was thoughtfully equipped for both adults and children, making it an excellent choice for a family beach vacation in Seagrove Beach. When you're taking a break from the beach, enjoy: • Cornhole • Two acoustic guitars • Games • Playing cards • Bicycles • Screened porch seating Families traveling with little ones will also appreciate the included: • Pack and Play • High chair • Children's dishes These thoughtful extras mean fewer things to pack and more time to enjoy your Seagrove Beach vacation. Incredible Seagrove Beach Location Seagrove Beach is one of the most beloved communities along Scenic Highway 30A, known for its beautiful beaches, coastal dune lakes, towering trees, charming neighborhoods and easy access to restaurants, shops and neighboring beach communities. The south-of-30A location of Just Us on 30A provides the peaceful beach atmosphere guests want while keeping you close to everything that makes 30A special. Explore nearby Eastern Lake, one of South Walton's unique coastal dune lakes, or venture out to discover the many restaurants, boutiques and entertainment options throughout Seagrove Beach and the neighboring 30A communities. Minutes from Seaside No 30A vacation is complete without visiting iconic Seaside, Florida. Spend an afternoon browsing Seaside's boutiques, grab lunch from the food trucks, enjoy coffee or ice cream, explore the town square and take in the distinctive architecture that has made Seaside one of the most recognizable beach communities in Florida. Afterward, return to the more relaxed surroundings of Just Us on 30A in Seagrove Beach. Dining Near Old Florida Fish House Food lovers will appreciate being close to Old Florida Fish House, a longtime Seagrove Beach favorite near Eastern Lake. The surrounding area also offers plenty of choices for morning coffee, casual lunches, fresh Gulf seafood, cocktails and memorable dinners. From local favorites to upscale dining, you can enjoy a different 30A restaurant every night or prepare your own meal in the home's fully stocked kitchen. Boutique Shopping, Dining and Entertainment Along 30A Spend time browsing locally owned boutiques, searching for the perfect vacation souvenir or exploring the shopping, dining and entertainment found throughout Seagrove Beach, Seaside and Scenic Highway 30A. Whether your perfect vacation means spending every day on the beach or dividing your time between the Gulf, shopping, dining and exploring, the convenient location of Just Us on 30A makes it easy to do it all. Your Seagrove Beach Vacation Starts at Just Us on 30A If you're searching for a luxury Seagrove Beach vacation rental south of 30A, Just Us on 30A brings together the location, comfort and amenities travelers want most. Walk to the beach. Cruise Seagrove Beach in the included 6-seater street-legal golf cart. Explore 30A by bicycle. Spend evenings relaxing on the private screened porch, playing cornhole, enjoying games with the family or picking up one of the acoustic guitars. With five bedrooms, four king beds, a bunk room, beautiful luxury décor, a fully stocked kitchen, bicycles, beach wagon and family-friendly amenities, Just Us on 30A offers an exceptional setting for your next Seagrove Beach, Santa Rosa Beach and Scenic Highway 30A vacation. Come experience the sugar-white beaches, emerald Gulf waters and relaxed coastal lifestyle that make Seagrove Beach and 30A one of Florida's most sought-after vacation destinations. Just Us on 30A — your place to gather, unwind and make memories at the beach. Pack less. Vacation more.
